race.description: Ladbrokes More On Tote Win Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: PANDA'S SPECTRUM (6) brings the strongest credentials through her last campaign, with a G3 SA Fillies Classic placing and G1 Queensland Oaks exposure giving her a clear form edge for this level. She's trialled well enough and can win if sharp enough at 1400m. RUSSIAN FRONT (13) comes off a beaten-favourite fifth at Kyneton, but the prior Pakenham Synthetic win was dominant and he can bounce back. DUNDONALD (10) resumes off a close Cranbourne trial after a consistent staying campaign, though his only 1400m attempt remains a small query. Should be staying on through the line. THE FLYING POPOV (12) has been sound in two runs back from a spell and should be ready to peak up to 1400m from a good draw.
